textos.O Evidēns condensa mais de 7 mil páginas: Evidēns condenses more than 7,000 pages of guidelines, from over 40 societies and health agencies, into a single algorithm. On one screen, it shows
textos.o que rastrear, quais exames pedir e qua: what to screen for, which tests to order and which vaccines to recommend
textos.— Sugestões para o médico revisar. A con: — Suggestions for the physician to review. The decision is always yours.
textos.O problema não é pedir mais ou menos exa: The problem is not ordering more or fewer tests.
It is ordering the right ones.
textos.Exame demais gera custo, falso-positivo: Too many tests bring cost, false positives and care cascades. Too few miss what matters.
textos.dos exames laboratoriais pedidos são des: of the lab tests ordered are unnecessary.
textos.dos exames indicados deixam de ser pedid: of the tests that are indicated are not ordered.
textos.por ano, nos EUA, em sobretratamento e c: per year, in the US, on overtreatment and low-value care.
textos.nos pedidos de exames de uso excessivo q: in requests for overused tests when the physician receives individualized feedback.
textos.O Evidēns leva a diretriz para a hora do: Evidēns brings the guideline to the moment of ordering:
textos.o que pedir, para quem e com qual referê: what to order, for whom and on which reference.
textos.Zhi M et al. Metanálise de 15 anos: 20,6: Zhi M et al. 15-year meta-analysis: 20.6% overuse and 44.8% underuse.
textos.Shrank WH et al. US$ 75,7 a 101,2 bilhõe: Shrank WH et al. US$ 75.7 to 101.2 billion per year, including tests, procedures and treatments.
textos.O’Connor DA et al. Ensaio randomizado co: O’Connor DA et al. Randomized trial of 5,964 family physicians among the highest requesters, in Australia.
textos.De diretrizes e documentos de referência: Of guidelines and reference documents, gathered in a single base.
textos.Sociedades médicas e órgãos de saúde do: Medical societies and health agencies from Brazil and around the world: SBIm, SBC, MS, USPSTF, AHA, ADA, ESC, KDIGO, NCCN, CDC and dozens of others.
textos.Decisão rápida, pedidos de exames e rece: Fast decisions, test orders and vaccine prescriptions, on a single screen.
textos.Recomendações extraídas de sociedades mé: Recommendations drawn from Brazilian and international medical societies and health agencies. Each check-up item cites its own.
textos.Federação Brasileira das Associações de: Brazilian Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics Associations
textos.Cada recomendação mostra a fonte e o ano: Each recommendation shows the source and year, with a link to the original document.
textos.7 mil páginas de diretrizes de mais de 4: 7,000 pages of guidelines from over 40 societies and health agencies
textos.. Em vez de procurar a resposta em dezen: . Instead of searching dozens of sources for the answer, in a few seconds you reach a plan based on scientific evidence.
textos.Idade, sexo, comorbidades, hábitos e his: Age, sex, comorbidities, habits and family history in organized fields.
textos.Perguntas objetivas antes das vacinas de: Objective questions before live-virus vaccines. "Not informed" is never treated as "no".
textos.O paciente tem imunossupressão, por doen: Is the patient immunosuppressed, by disease or by treatment?
textos.Decide tríplice viral, varicela, febre a: Determines MMR, varicella, yellow fever and dengue
textos.Check-up baseado em evidência, com pedid: Evidence-based check-up, with test orders and vaccine prescription in PDF, ready to print, sign and stamp.
textos.Uma plataforma feita para organizar e le: A platform built to organize and bring to the bedside, concisely, the latest scientific evidence from around the world.
textos.Glicemia, lipídios, Lp(a), função renal,: Glucose, lipids, Lp(a), kidney function, PSA…
textos.Gerar pedidos e receita em PDF: Generate orders and prescription as PDF
Less time looking for the right guideline. More time explaining to the patient why to screen, and what to do with the result.
textos.Tecnologia que devolve tempo à conversa: Technology that gives time back to the clinical conversation.
textos.Não. Ele organiza o que as diretrizes re: No. It organizes what the guidelines recommend for that profile. Each item is a suggestion for you to review and individualize; the decision and the signature are yours.
textos.para o check-up do adulto: rastreamento,: for the adult check-up: screening, laboratory tests, imaging tests and vaccines, adjusted for age, sex, comorbidities, habits, family history and pregnancy. Each item brings its source and interval. From the list, the platform generates PDF drafts of the test orders and the vaccine prescription.
textos.Quais diretrizes estão por trás das reco: Which guidelines are behind the recommendations?
textos.Cada recomendação mostra a fonte e o ano: Each recommendation shows the source and year, with a link to the document.
textos.Para médicos que fazem consulta de check: For physicians who see adults (18 years or older) for check-ups: internal medicine, family medicine, cardiology, gynecology and related fields.
textos.A pediatria ainda não faz parte, e o pré: Pediatrics is not included yet, and prenatal care covers the low-risk routine. In pregnancy, Evidēns builds the tests by gestational age, postpones adult screening that does not apply and adjusts the vaccines.
textos.Disponível para médicos, residentes e es: Available to physicians, residents and medical students.
textos.Check-up do adulto baseado em diretrizes: Guideline-based adult check-up, to support the physician's decision.
textos.Sugestões para avaliação do médico — não: Suggestions for the physician's assessment — they are not a prescription and do not replace the consultation.
